content: Plan: Add seq_names: Vec<String> and seq_lengths: HashMap<String, u64> fields to Reader. Populated at construction by calling C FFI (faidx_nseq, faidx_iseq, faidx_seq_len64) once. Then n_seqs(), seq_name(), fetch_seq_len() serve from cache — no more FFI calls for these three functions. Differential tests: compare C FFI results against cached values for real FASTA files.
